\emph{Notes:} Canonical new-money issues, official-statement corpus 2005--25 (package v3), local governments only; dollar-weighted by effective par. Authorisation is the detailed partition of determined dollars (93.7\% of documents): Voters = any voter authorisation (voter-only plus jointly voter-and-board), of which the \emph{joint} sub-column is the both-authorised case; Board = board only; Statute = statutory. A voted general-obligation bond is normally jointly authorised (the referendum authorises, the board resolution implements), so the both-case is counted as voter authorisation. The single-valued collapse used elsewhere in the municipal-finance literature assigns joint issues to the board and so understates voter authorisation; the collapsed voter share is a lower bound (schools 63.4\% against 68.2\%; all classes 32.1\% against 35.0\%). Security shares are of all dollars ('other' and unclassified omitted). Conduit issues without an accountable local government (11,750 documents, largely authority-class vehicles) are excluded here and appear in the menu matrix (Table A5).
